# Releases that were tagged but NEVER version-stamped.
#
# Each line is a published annotated tag vX.Y.Z for which NO COMMIT IN THE
# REPOSITORY — on any ref, ever — carries that string in /version. The release
# was cut without running the version bump, so the tag was created against
# whatever commit was at hand.
#
# These cannot be repaired. Retagging requires a commit that carries the
# string, and there is none; moving or deleting a published tag is a force
# operation on shared history and an OPERATOR decision, not CI's.
#
# WHY THIS FILE HAS TO EXIST
# --------------------------
# version-consistency.yml asserts that the annotated tag matching the CURRENT
# /version sits on a commit whose own /version reads the same string. That
# assertion is correct and it stays. But it is evaluated against whatever
# /version happens to say, so a wrong tag from the past becomes a LANDMINE: the
# moment /version is bumped to a version already carrying a bad tag, main goes
# red on a defect that no commit in the PR caused and that no PR can fix.
#
# v6.0.82 is exactly that landmine. Its tag points at 18c50809, whose /version
# reads v6.0.81. The next time this repo releases 6.0.82, main breaks.
#
# So the assertion is scoped by this ledger instead of being weakened: a version
# listed here reports the defect loudly and does not block the release. Anything
# NOT listed here is enforced exactly as strictly as before.
#
# ENFORCED IN BOTH DIRECTIONS. A version listed here whose tag DOES resolve to a
# truthfully-stamped commit fails the build too, so the list is forced to shrink
# if a tag is ever legitimately repaired and can never rot into a blanket
# exemption that swallows the next real defect.
#
# DO NOT ADD A LINE HERE TO MAKE A RED CHECK GO AWAY. The only qualifying
# condition is "no commit in this repository has ever carried this version
# string", which is verifiable:
#
#   git log --all --format=%H -- version \
#     | while read -r s; do git show "$s:version" 2>/dev/null | head -1; done \
#     | grep -cx vX.Y.Z        # must print 0
#
# Verified 0 for all six entries below on 2026-07-31 against 243 distinct
# version strings across all refs.
#
# Format: vX.Y.Z  # tag target -> version that commit actually carries
#
v6.0.75  # tag -> a0e9739c, whose /version reads v6.0.74
v6.0.76  # tag -> 2e377760, whose /version reads v6.0.74
v6.0.77  # tag -> 63831889, whose /version reads v6.0.74
v6.0.78  # tag -> 5cdeb48c, whose /version reads v6.0.74
v6.0.79  # tag -> fbad03c7, whose /version reads v6.0.74
v6.0.82  # tag -> 18c50809, whose /version reads v6.0.81
